# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/env-docs.mjs from platform/runtime/config/env.ts. Edit that list, then run node scripts/env-docs.mjs --write. -->

Chausar reads these environment variables. None is needed to run the desktop app: it sets the ones it uses itself. Someone running the local server or the hosted server from source may set the others; `.env.example` lists the usual ones. Data folders must be absolute paths outside the code folder.

Read by: desktop (the Electron app), worker (its engine process), server (the local web server), hosted (the hosted server), engine (any of them), child (a process Chausar starts and gives the variable to), scripts (build, test and release scripts), ci (the GitHub workflows). A secret is never written in a file in this repository.

| Variable | What it does | When unset | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAUSAR_AGENT_API_KEY` (secret) | The owner's API key, handed to a Codex agent run that uses a key connection instead of a sign-in. | Unset: Codex uses its own sign-in. | child |
| `CHAUSAR_AGENT_MCP_SOCKET` | The local socket the agent's MCP bridge connects to, set by the engine for the bridge it starts. | Set by the engine; the bridge refuses to start without it. | child |
| `CHAUSAR_AGENT_MCP_TOKEN` (secret) | The one-run token the MCP bridge presents to the engine, set by the engine for the bridge it starts. | Set by the engine; the bridge refuses to start without it. | child |
| `CHAUSAR_ALLOW_REPO_DATA` | Set to 1 to allow a data folder or run output inside the code folder (for one-off debugging only). | Unset: a data folder or output inside the checkout is refused (DATA_INSIDE_REPO). | engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_APP_REVIEWED` | Comma-separated ids of the platform app reviews this install has passed, so their posting connectors may write. | Unset: no app review is recorded; those connectors stay read-only or hand-off. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_AUTO_BACKUPS` | Set to off to stop the automatic encrypted backups of each business. | Unset: automatic backups are on. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_BENCH_FREE_BYTES` | A stand-in free-space number for bench.mjs, read by that script only, so its own test can fake it. | Unset: the bench measures the temp drive. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_BROWSER_PROFILES` | The folder that holds the per-platform browser sign-in profiles. | Unset: ~/.chausar/browser-sessions. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_CLAUDE_CODE_TERMS` | Set to pending to turn the Claude Code way off until its terms are accepted. | Unset: Claude Code is available. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_CODEX_BUNDLE_DIR` | The folder of the Codex shipped with the desktop app, set by the desktop for the engine. | Unset: no bundled Codex; only the owner's own Codex is used. | desktop, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_CODEX_CLI_EVIDENCE_FILE` | An operator-supplied manifest of a reviewed Codex command-line setup (paired with its SHA-256). | Unset: the recorded setups in the trust folder are used. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_CODEX_CLI_EVIDENCE_SHA256` | The SHA-256 of the manifest named by CHAUSAR_CODEX_CLI_EVIDENCE_FILE. | Unset: as above. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_CODEX_TRUST_DIR` | The folder where recorded Codex setups are kept, set by the desktop for the engine. | Unset: no recorded setup can be kept. | desktop, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_DEMO` | Set to 1 by the desktop when it runs the demo business. | Unset or 0: the real data folder. | desktop, worker, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_DEVICE_KEYS` | Set to none to keep vault keys out of the computer's protected storage and ask for a passphrase instead. | Unset: the computer's protected storage keeps each vault key. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_ENGINE_VERSION` | The app version the engine reports, set by the desktop from its package. | Unset: the engine reports no version. | desktop, worker, engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_FEEDBACK_POSTHOG_HOST` | The PostHog host a build ships for owner-approved feedback, read when packaging. | Unset: the build ships no feedback keys. | desktop, engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_FEEDBACK_POSTHOG_KEY` (secret) | The PostHog project key a build ships for owner-approved feedback, read when packaging. | Unset: the build ships no feedback keys. | desktop, engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_FEEDBACK_SENTRY_DSN` (secret) | The Sentry address a build ships for owner-approved crash reports, read when packaging. | Unset: the build ships no crash report address. | desktop, engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_HOME` | The data home: a local server or worker keeps its data in CHAUSAR_HOME/&lt;kind&gt;. | Unset: the per-user folder (on Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\Chausar\dev\&lt;kind&gt;). | server, hosted, engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED` | Set to 1 to start the experimental hosted server (or pass --hosted). | Unset: hosted mode is off. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_AI_CEILING_MICROS` | The hosted server's monthly AI spend ceiling per account, in micro US dollars. | Unset: the built-in ceiling. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_BUSINESSES_PER_ACCOUNT` | How many businesses one hosted account may keep. | Unset: the built-in number. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_CUSTODY_KEY` (secret) | The hosted server's master key (32 random bytes, base64url) that opens every vault on it. | Unset: refused, except in --dev. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_DATA` | The hosted server's data folder. | Unset: CHAUSAR_HOME/hosted, else the per-user folder. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_LISTEN` | The address the hosted server listens on. | Unset: 127.0.0.1. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_MAILER` | How the hosted server sends sign-in mail. | Unset: dev-outbox in --dev, else none. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_ORIGIN` | The hosted server's public https address, like https://app.example.com. | Unset: refused, except in --dev (http://localhost:4320). | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_PORT` | The hosted server's port. | Unset: the origin's port, else 4320 in --dev, else 8443. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_POSTGRES_URL` (secret) | The hosted server's PostgreSQL address on loopback, when its storage is postgres. | Unset: refused when the storage is postgres. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_PUSH` | Set to 0 to turn off phone alerts by web push on the hosted server. | Unset: on. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_PUSH_CONTACT` | The mailto: or https: contact that web push services see. | Unset: the server's https origin. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_STORAGE` | Where the hosted server keeps businesses: experimental-file or postgres. | Unset: experimental-file. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TLS_CERT` | The hosted server's TLS certificate file (set with CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TLS_KEY). | Unset: an https origin needs a TLS proxy instead. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TLS_KEY` (secret) | The hosted server's TLS key file (set with CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TLS_CERT). | Unset: as above. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TLS_PROXY` | Set to 1 when a TLS proxy stands in front of the hosted server. | Unset: an https origin needs a certificate. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TRIALS` | Set to 1 or 0: whether people may start a hosted trial without an account. | Unset: off, on in --dev. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TRIALS_LIVE` | How many hosted trials may run at once (1 to 100000). | Unset: the built-in number. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TRIAL_AI_CEILING_MICROS` | The AI spend ceiling of one hosted trial, in micro US dollars. | Unset: the built-in ceiling. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TRIAL_IDLE_DAYS` | Days a hosted trial may sit unused before it is removed (1 to 30). | Unset: the built-in number. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TRIAL_VAULT_BYTES` | The largest vault one hosted trial may keep, in bytes (1 MB to 256 MB). | Unset: the built-in size. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_HOSTED_TRUST_PROXY` | How many trusted proxies stand in front of the hosted server (true means 1). | Unset: 0, the socket address is the client. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_INK_ROOT` | The absolute folder of the built Ink app, set by the desktop for the engine's web host. | Unset: app/ui/dist beside the source. | desktop, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_JOB_LEASE_MS` | The lease of a typed background job, in milliseconds (with the other two job variables). | Unset: typed jobs are off in that process. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_JOB_MAX_ACTIVE` | How many typed background jobs run at once (with the other two job variables). | Unset: typed jobs are off in that process. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_JOB_WORKER_ID` | The id this process uses to lease typed background jobs (with the other two job variables). | Unset: typed jobs are off in that process. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_PERF_STAND_IN` | A JSON file of stand-in measures for perf-budgets.mjs, read by that script only, so its test runs no measure. | Unset: the real measures run. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_PORT` | The local web server's port. | Unset: 4317. | server |
| `CHAUSAR_POSTGRES_URL` (secret) | The local server's PostgreSQL address, for real (non-demo) storage. | Unset: real storage cannot start; the demo uses file storage. | server |
| `CHAUSAR_PRIVATE_DIR` | Where the private repository is checked out, for the screenshot walk's --publish. | Unset: ../chausar-private beside this checkout. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_PUBLIC_URL` | The hosted server's own public origin, used for client share links. | Unset: share links get no address. | hosted, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_PYTHON` | The Python the analytics helper runs with. | Unset: the desktop sets its bundled Python; the local server finds none. | desktop, server, worker |
| `CHAUSAR_RECORDINGS_UPDATE` | Set by recordings:update to regenerate sample-only real-engine answers for UI tests. | Unset: scenarios compare the checked-in answers and refuse changes. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_RELEASE_KEY` (secret) | The Ed25519 private key that signs the update feed, an Actions secret the release workflow writes to a private runner temp file for scripts/release-feed.mjs. | Unset: the release workflow stops before the feed is signed. | ci |
| `CHAUSAR_RELEASE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE` (secret) | The file holding the release signing private key, read by the packaging preflight. | Unset: refused where a signed release is asked for. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE` | The file holding the release signing public key, read by the packaging preflight. | Unset: refused where a signed release is asked for. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_RUN_ROOT` | Where test receipts, perf budgets and the screenshot walk write. | Unset: &lt;temp&gt;/chausar-runs/&lt;date&gt;-&lt;name&gt;. | engine, scripts, ci |
| `CHAUSAR_SITE_FOLDER` | The absolute folder of the owner's website on this computer, which staged site edits apply to. | Unset: no site folder; site edits stay staged. | engine |
| `CHAUSAR_TEST_DATABASE_DISPOSABLE` | Set to 1 to confirm the database-differential check may use a fresh, disposable local database. | Unset: that check refuses to run. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL` (secret) | The disposable local PostgreSQL address for the database-differential check. | Unset: that check refuses to run. | scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_UPDATES_DIRECTORY` | The folder for the daily update check: its state, the staged installer and the log. The desktop sets it inside its user data folder. | Unset: no daily update check runs. | desktop, worker |
| `CHAUSAR_UPDATE_CHANNEL` | Which release channel the daily check reads, beta or stable. | Unset: the channel the owner kept, else the build's own. | desktop, worker |
| `CHAUSAR_UPDATE_FEED` | The address of the signed update feed, from the build's package.json. | Unset: updates read as not set up. | desktop, worker |
| `CHAUSAR_UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY` | The publisher's PEM public key that update feeds are checked against; never taken from a model. | Unset: updates are not checked or offered. | engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_VAULT_DIRECTORY` | The folder that holds the business vaults; the desktop sets it to its own user data folder. | Unset: the data home (CHAUSAR_HOME/&lt;kind&gt;, else the per-user folder); a hand-started worker refuses. | desktop, worker, server, engine, scripts |
| `CHAUSAR_VENTURE_GITHUB_REPLAY` | A recorded GitHub answers file for the demo, used only with replay on. | Unset: no GitHub replay. | hosted, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_VENTURE_MODEL_REPLAY` | A recorded AI answers file for the demo, used only with replay on. | Unset: no AI replay. | hosted, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_VENTURE_REPLAY` | Set to 1 (or pass --replay) in demo or --dev mode to answer from the recorded files. | Unset: off. | hosted, engine |
| `CHAUSAR_VENTURE_RUNTIME` | Which venture runtime the hosted server uses; only local exists. | Unset: local. | hosted |
| `CHAUSAR_WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_THUMBPRINT` | The exact 40-character certificate thumbprint a Windows installer must be signed with before it may run by itself. | Unset: a Windows owner gets Show installer; nothing runs by itself. | desktop, worker |
